text: The lab compares the ESN against a naive ___ baseline, defined by predicting y_pred(t) = y_true(t−1) — simply repeating the previous value.
explanation: The lab sets y_persist = u_test (which equals y_true shifted by one step) as the persistence baseline. It does reasonably well on 1-step prediction but degrades badly under closed-loop operation, setting a lower bound for 'useful' prediction.
